hypotheses.description: Disabling Confidence raises total_reversions relative to Exp-001 (0 reversions), indicating that Confidence is independently responsible for part of the reversion suppression in full governance — not just Reversibility.

Disabling Confidence raises contested_claim_resolution_rate relative to Exp-001 (0.02), because without a confidence gate, contested claims resolve faster (Premature Binary Collapse failure mode). Rate is predicted to be significantly above 0.02 and closer to the null baseline (2.5).
epistemic_accuracy decreases relative to Exp-001 (0.6) when Confidence is disabled, because without the threshold gate, false claims are operationalised at the same rate as true ones.
